cases.name: std-import-as-and-with-forms
cases.source:
import "std:text" as t
print(t.find("hello", "ll"))
import "std:text" with find, ends_with
print(find("abc", "c"), ends_with("abc", "bc"))

cases.name: std-runs-under-the-importers-limits
cases.source:
import "std:text" as text
let i = 0
while i < 100 {
  text.find("hello", "l")
  i = i + 1
}
print(i)
cases.error: LimitError: step budget of 500 steps exhausted - is there a loop that never ends?
cases.error_like: ^LimitError: step budget of 500 steps exhausted - is there a loop that never ends\?$

cases.name: std-text-find
cases.source:
import "std:text" as text
print(text.find("hello", "ll"), text.find("hello", "he"), text.find("hello", "x"), text.find("hello", ""), text.find("", ""), text.find("aXbX", "X"))
print(text.find("héllo", "l"))

cases.name: std-text-find-from
cases.source:
import "std:text" as text
print(text.find_from("abcabc", "b", 2), text.find_from("abc", "c", -5), text.find_from("abc", "", 99), text.find_from("abc", "a", 1), text.find_from("abc", "a", 0))

cases.name: std-text-starts-and-ends-with
cases.source:
import "std:text" as text
print(text.starts_with("hello", "he"), text.starts_with("he", "hello"), text.starts_with("a", ""), text.starts_with("", ""), text.starts_with("hello", "lo"))
print(text.ends_with("hello", "llo"), text.ends_with("lo", "hello"), text.ends_with("a", ""), text.ends_with("", ""), text.ends_with("hello", "he"))

cases.name: std-text-is-number-and-parse-number
cases.source:
import "std:text" as text
print(text.is_number("12"), text.is_number("-3.5"), text.is_number("abc"), text.is_number(""))
print(text.parse_number("7", 0), text.parse_number("x", -1), text.parse_number("2.5", 0))
print(text.is_number("12") == (num("12") == 12))

cases.name: std-text-basename
cases.source:
import "std:text" as text
print(text.basename("a/b/c.txt"), text.basename("c.txt"), text.basename("a\\b.txt"), text.basename("a/b/") == "", text.basename("") == "")

cases.name: std-text-splitext

print(text.splitext("noext"), text.splitext("a/b.c/d.e"))
